title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Bright soundboard captures a tight, high‑energy ’82 second set with smoking China > Rider, Iko Iko and a soaring Black Peter.
ai_review.review: The recording is a crisp, bright‑sounding soundboard that lets the band’s tight arrangements shine.  Reviewers rave about the incendiary second set – from the punchy China Cat → Rider to the uplifting Iko Iko and haunting Black Peter – noting relentless energy right through Drumz/Space.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both performance (tight, energetic second set) and audio quality (bright, clear soundboard) across seven detailed reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bright, very nice clarity; drum mix highlighted as especially good; no reported drop‑outs or major flaws.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set packed with upbeat numbers before Drumz/Space, maintaining high momentum and tight transitions throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: High‑energy playing throughout, especially leading into Drumz/Space; praised for driving the set forward.
band_member_comments.Bob: Strong vocal on Estimated Prophet and energetic rhythm work noted.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bright, punchy drum sound highlighted as a standout element of the mix.
